worldcombat.skill.magnitude.summary: Presses down and rolls this cast's magnitude first (4..10, shown right away), lets the ground pre-shudder for about 0.3 s, then makes it quake in place: every grounded foe in the ring takes a hit, heavier the higher it lands; leave the ground during the pre-shudder to dodge it. A strong enough quake interrupts a foe's action. Deep focus rolls higher, reaches wider and interrupts more reliably, but is slower.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.use.0: Quake every grounded foe standing around you at once
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.use.1: Interrupt a foe that is charging or attacking
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.use.2: Skip airborne targets and hit the ones standing
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.use.3: Harass repeatedly on a very short cooldown
At magnitude 7 each grounded foe in the ring takes about %1$s damage; a cast scales with the rolled magnitude (4/5/6/7/8/9/10 as x0.14/0.43/0.71/1/1.29/1.57/2.14). The target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
It reaches %1$s blocks; those caught are jolted upward at %2$s blocks/tick and staggered %3$s blocks, up to %4$s grounded foes per cast. Airborne targets are not shaken.
At a rolled magnitude of %1$s or more, the current action of anyone caught is broken; actions that cannot be interrupted are unaffected.
On commit it shows the magnitude it rolled and pre-shudders the ground for about 0.3 s before the quake settles; leave the ground during the pre-shudder to dodge this hit.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.fault.on: Deep focus: the rolled magnitude is shifted +1 (higher floor, higher average), the reach is x1.15 and the interrupt threshold -1, at wind-up +4 and cooldown +14.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.fault.off: Shallow focus: the magnitude may land anywhere in 4..10 (possibly small), the reach is x0.9, and wind-up and cooldown are shorter for faster hands.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.timing: Can only be used while grounded; it reaches %1$s blocks. After %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.growth.0: At level %1$s the magnitude power rises to %2$s, the reach to %3$s blocks, and the interrupt threshold drops to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.preference.f: On (deep focus): the rolled magnitude is shifted +1 (higher floor and average), reach x1.15 and interrupt threshold -1, at wind-up +4 and cooldown +14 - steady heavy damage and reliable interrupts. Off (shallow focus): the magnitude may land anywhere in 4..10 (possibly small), reach x0.9 and shorter wind-up/cooldown - fast, repeated harassment.
worldcombat.skill.magnitude.preference.a: The companion only considers Magnitude when a threat is this close; lower it to quake only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible, grounded foes must stand inside the ring before it quakes; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to quake at a single target.
